# Agent Note: The session-cost detail card

Status: implemented

English | [中文](2026-09-13-session-cost-card.zh.md)

## Problem

The composer strip answered "what has this conversation cost" and the per-route consumption lived in a native `title` on the figure. A native tooltip is a single unformatted string with no structure, no scroll bound, no keyboard reach, and no dismissal contract: a fifty-child delegation produced fifty concatenated lines with no way to fold them, and the price-settings path was only discoverable by hovering. The reference surface the user asked for is the 「Token 用量」 card the composer's stats pills already open — a portaled panel with a heading row, a hairline rule, and rows.

## Decision

**The figure is a button that opens a card.** The trigger keeps the row's readout typography (a reset button, no chip) and carries `aria-haspopup="dialog"` plus `aria-expanded`; click, Enter, and Space toggle it, Escape, an outside `pointerdown`, and a second press on the trigger close it. Escape returns focus to the trigger, because the panel is portaled and unmounts. The card is `role="dialog"` labelled by `sessionCost.title`, portaled to `document.body`, and its heading row mirrors the reference card: glyph and section name left, headline total right, then a hairline rule and the rows.

**The surface is rebuilt from primitives, not imported.** `ui-chat`'s `stat-dialog` seat and CSS module are another feature plugin's private values, and the client rules forbid a runtime import between feature plugins. The card therefore composes `useAnchoredPosition` (viewport-clamped placement above the trigger), `useDismissOnOutsidePointer`, `usePresence` (the shared `popover` recipe), and `useAnchoredMaxHeight`, and its CSS module consumes the same semantic aliases as the reference surface (`--dsw-specific-menu`, r12, `--dsw-elevation-prominent`, `--dsw-alias-border-l2`, the label tints) instead of copying that module. `HoverCard` cannot serve: it opens on a dwell and dismisses on any anchor press.

**The placement waits for the panel it measures.** `usePresence` mounts the panel on the commit after `open` flips, so the seat asks for placement with `open && mounted`, not `open`. Asked a commit early, `useAnchoredPosition` reads the absent panel's offset size as height 0 and pins the card by its top edge 8px above the trigger, so the card grows downward over the composer; nothing corrects it, because the hook's dependencies do not move again and its `ResizeObserver` was never attached to a null panel. Closing still nulls the placement, so the exiting panel keeps the hidden measure style for the length of the popover fade rather than repainting at a stale edge.

**All sources merge into one route table before pricing.** `mergeBilledUsage` folds the current Session's `billedUsage` and every descendant's into one projection keyed by `provider/model` — buckets summed, first-seen order kept, the composite key unambiguous because a provider route id never contains `/`. The card then lists exactly one row per model, so a model the parent and three children billed is one row and the header total is the sum of the rows; before this, the total was a sum over per-source breakdowns and the rows were per source, which the card could not reconcile.

**The delegation tree is one folded row.** A session that delegated shows a single `子代理 n 个 · 费用 ¥X.XX · 命中 … · 未命中 … · 输出 …` row — `ui-primitives`' `DisclosureRow`, collapsed by default, whole-row keyboard operable, `aria-expanded` honest. The row is one line by construction: `white-space: nowrap` forbids the second line outright, `min-width: 0` on a `flex: 1 1 auto` item lets it shrink instead of widening the row, a trailing chevron that cannot shrink keeps the affordance visible, and `overflow: hidden` + `text-overflow: ellipsis` are the last-resort tail for content wider than the viewport. Expanding renders one line per child (name, its own cost or the no-price notice, its combined token line carrying its own cache-hit rate), capped at ten lines with a truthful `还有 n 个` remainder. The subtotal prices what it can: children whose route resolves to no price print 没有设置价格, are excluded from the subtotal, and are counted in the summary without pricing it — a subtotal that can price nothing says 没有设置价格 rather than ¥0.00.

**Every consumption line carries its own cache-hit rate inline.** The parenthetical sits immediately after the line's `命中` figure (`sessionCost.hitRateInline` = `（{percent}%）` / ` ({percent}%)`), never as a row of its own and never at the end of a line. A route's peak and off-peak lines rate their own period's buckets — a period line printing the combined rate would answer a question that line does not ask — while a child's line rates that child's combined tokens and the folded summary rates the whole subtree. The denominator is the prompt side only (cache reads plus misses; cache writes fold into the miss side) and the two periods of one source combine; a source that billed no prompt token omits the parenthetical entirely rather than printing 0%. Rounding is whole-percent with positive ties up, except that a partial hit is never rounded up to a full 100 — the formatter adds exactly the precision that keeps the miss visible (`99.9`, `99.9999`), mirroring ui-chat's private formatter the way `formatTokenCount` mirrors its own.

**The card is bounded in both directions, and its width follows its content.** `width: max-content` with `max-width: calc(100vw - 24px)` — no fixed cap — so a long row widens the card to the viewport margin instead of being clipped to an arbitrary width, and the ellipsis on the summary row's text is a last-resort fallback for content wider than the viewport rather than the everyday reading. The clamps that keep the panel inside the viewport read its real geometry: `useAnchoredPosition` measures `offsetWidth` and shifts the card left, and it re-measures through its `ResizeObserver` when the content changes that width. The child-name column keeps no percentage cap, because a percentage inside a `max-content` box resolves against the width the content is supposed to decide. In the other direction the route rows are one per billed model by construction, the child lines are capped, and the panel's height is clamped by `useAnchoredMaxHeight` against the space above the trigger, with only the row area scrolling; a session with fifty subagents therefore renders one route block, one disclosure row, and at most ten child lines. The row area scrolls vertically only (`overflow: hidden auto` — `overflow-y: auto` on its own computes a horizontal `auto` too, which would turn a stray wide row into a sideways scrollbar), and the card keeps ONE left edge: the panel's padding is its only horizontal inset, the child rows and the overflow line carry no left indent, and the disclosure row's own affordance carries the nesting instead.

**An unpriced state stays actionable.** The reminder the strip shows when no billed route is priced is the same trigger, so the path to the one price editor (设置 → 消耗统计 → 计费设置) is inside the card — rendered whenever a billed route has no price, partial or total. The trigger carries no native `title`, and neither does any ancestor: the phase half's schedule hint moved onto the phase group, because an ancestor's title applies to the figure as well.

## Alternatives considered

**Import `ui-chat`'s stat-dialog seat or its CSS module.** Rejected: a feature plugin may not runtime-import another feature plugin's values, and copying a private CSS module would fork the skin instead of consuming the shared aliases.

**Promote a click-opened popover into `ui-primitives`.** Deferred, not rejected: the only current consumer is this card, the package's own rule asks a promoted control to have reuse or a promotion reason, and the change would reach a package outside this feature's allowed touch. The seat is one small module here and can move if a second consumer appears.

**Keep the native `title` beside the card.** Rejected: two mechanisms on one target, and the tooltip's plain text could not carry rows, a subtotal, or a fold.

**Render one block per source (the previous behaviour), with `子代理：<name>` prefixes.** Reversed by this change: the reader asking "what did this model cost" had to add up one block per child, and a model billed by the parent and by ten children printed eleven blocks. The per-source detail survives as the folded disclosure, which answers the other question — which child spent what.

**Put every child on its own route row.** Rejected: the route rows answer a pricing question, not a delegation question; a child that ran two models would split one child across rows and inflate the card the fold exists to keep compact.

**Fold children into the routes with no disclosure at all.** Rejected: the header total then contains money the reader cannot account for, and an unpriced child would be invisible rather than reported.

**Bound the child lines without letting the card scroll.** Rejected: routes are already bounded, but a session with many models and a long expanded list still needs the height clamp — the cap bounds the DOM, the clamp bounds the viewport.

## Consequences

The strip's detail is now reachable by pointer and by keyboard, structured, and bounded, and its total and rows agree by construction. The cost is a second render path in the row (the portaled card), a merge pass per usage or price change, and a set of locale keys for the card (title, partial marker, subagent summary, child line, remainder). The honesty rules are unchanged in kind: an unpriced route prints 没有设置价格 and its tokens, a child with no reported usage itemizes nothing, and a merge never re-rates one route's tokens at another route's column.

Verification is pinned in the package. `session-cost-row.client.spec.tsx` covers the trigger's click, keyboard, Escape (with focus return), outside-press, and second-press dismissal; the card's exact content for a priced route, an unpriced route, a two-route mixed session, and the pre-billing upcoming route; an open card repricing through a new sample and a price edit; the per-period rate lines (one route reading 100% in peak and 0% off-peak from its own buckets, and a period omitting the parenthetical when it billed no prompt token); the summary row's trailing affordance and the stylesheet declarations that keep that row to one line, plus the panel's width declarations (content-driven, bounded only by the viewport margin, no fixed cap, no percentage cap on the name column) — jsdom has no layout, so these CSS contracts are read as text; the placement invariant itself (with a stubbed trigger rect and a stubbed panel height, the rendered `top` is `triggerRect.top − gap − height`, never the height-zero placement that pinned the card to the anchor's top edge); the merged single row for a model billed by the session and a child; the disclosure's default-collapsed state, its keyboard expansion, the catalog-label preference, grandchildren, an unpriced child's exclusion from the subtotal, the capped expansion with its remainder, and the no-descendant and absent-seat cases. `price-calculator.client.spec.ts` covers the fold itself: one summed row per model, two providers kept apart, first-seen order, empty input, and the merged buckets not aliasing a source's — plus the cache-hit rate itself: two periods combined into one rate, a full hit reading 100, an all-miss source reading 0, an output-only source with no rate at all, and the partial-hit precision that never rounds up to a full hit.
